title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins is swept into a quest to reclaim the dwarves' mountain home from the dragon Smaug, discovering courage he never knew he had.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe, a legendary figure living in obscurity, recounts how a gifted orphan became the most notorious wizard his world has ever seen.

title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R.R. Martin
description: Noble families vie for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient darkness stirs beyond the Wall in this epic of intrigue and betrayal.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: On the storm-ravaged world of Roshar, a soldier, a scholar, and a highprince are drawn toward the secrets of the ancient Knights Radiant.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Paul Atreides inherits a desert planet that is the sole source of the most precious substance in the universe, and a destiny larger than empires.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A lone astronaut wakes with no memory aboard a ship far from home, tasked with saving Earth — and finds the most unlikely ally imaginable.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: Child prodigy Ender Wiggin is drafted into an orbital battle school where war games and reality blur in humanity's fight for survival.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: Stranded alone on Mars, astronaut Mark Watney refuses to die, engineering his survival one impossible problem at a time.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant hacker untangle a decades-old disappearance rooted in one of Sweden's wealthiest families.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Amy Dunne vanishes — and every clue points to her husband, whose version of the marriage keeps shifting.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: A murder in the Louvre pulls symbologist Robert Langdon into a race across Europe to decode a secret guarded for two thousand years.

title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island, where an unseen host begins killing them one by one according to a sinister nursery rhyme.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr. Darcy in a sparkling comedy of manners about first impressions and second chances.

title: The Notebook
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: Noah reads to Allie from a worn notebook, retelling the summer romance that defined their lives and refuses to be forgotten.

title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: Louisa Clark takes a job caring for the paralyzed Will Traynor, and the two remake each other's ideas of what a life worth living means.

title: Outlander
author: Diana Gabaldon
description: Wartime nurse Claire Randall touches an ancient stone circle and is thrown two centuries back into the dangerous Scottish Highlands of 1743.

title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: From the cognitive revolution to the age of algorithms, a sweeping account of how one species came to rule the planet.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical framework for building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny changes that compound into remarkable results.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: Raised in a survivalist family that kept her out of school, Tara Westover fights her way to a PhD — and reckons with what education costs.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman maps the two systems that drive the way we think, and the biases that quietly steer our judgment.

author: George Orwell
description: In a state where Big Brother watches everything, Winston Smith commits the gravest crime of all: thinking for himself.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: Through Scout Finch's eyes, a small Alabama town confronts its conscience when her father defends a Black man falsely accused of a crime.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Jay Gatsby throws glittering parties for one impossible dream in Fitzgerald's brief, perfect elegy for the American Dream.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: Seven generations of the Buendía family rise and fall in Macondo, in the novel that defined magical realism.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: A thousand years after the Dark Lord conquered the world, a street urchin with a rare power joins a crew plotting the impossible: overthrowing an immortal emperor.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
author: C.S. Lewis
description: Four siblings step through an old wardrobe into the snowbound land of Narnia, where a white witch has silenced spring and only a great lion can bring it back.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Frodo Baggins inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out from the Shire with a fellowship sworn to see it destroyed before it destroys them.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphan raised in a cupboard under the stairs discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard, and that a school called Hogwarts is waiting for him.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: As a galactic empire crumbles, a mathematician's science of predicting the future gives humanity one chance to shorten thirty thousand years of barbarism to one.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: A washed-up hacker is hired for one last job that pulls him into a conspiracy spanning cyberspace, artificial intelligence, and orbital habitats of the ultra-rich.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: An envoy sent to a world without fixed gender must cross a killing ice sheet with the exiled prime minister who may be his only ally, or his executioner.

title: Snow Crash
author: Neal Stephenson
description: A pizza-delivery hacker and a skateboard courier uncover a computer virus that infects both the internet and the human mind.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A famous painter stops speaking the day she shoots her husband. A criminal psychotherapist becomes obsessed with uncovering the truth she has locked inside her silence.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Sherlock Holmes investigates a curse said to haunt the Baskerville family in the form of a spectral hound roaming the Devon moors.

title: Big Little Lies
author: Liane Moriarty
description: Three mothers at the same school become entangled in a lie that spirals toward a killing on trivia night, and no one is telling the police the whole truth.

title: In the Woods
author: Tana French
description: A detective investigating a child's murder in a Dublin suburb must confront the unsolved disappearance of two friends from the same woods twenty years earlier — his own.

title: The Hating Game
author: Sally Thorne
description: Two rival executive assistants who despise each other are forced together for a promotion, and the line between loathing and longing gets very thin.

title: Beach Read
author: Emily Henry
description: A heartbroken romance novelist and a literary novelist with writer's block swap genres for the summer in neighboring lake houses.

title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
description: A woman who built a life far from her difficult childhood falls for a man whose passion could turn possessive, and must decide what she is willing to repeat.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Bronte
description: An orphaned governess falls for her brooding employer, only to discover a secret locked away in his house that will test everything she believes about love and self-respect.

title: Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking
author: Susan Cain
description: A case for the underestimated strengths of introverts in a culture that rewards the bold and the loud, drawn from psychology, biography, and the author's own quiet life.

title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
author: Rebecca Skloot
description: The cells taken without her knowledge from a poor Black tobacco farmer in 1951 became one of the most important tools in medicine. Her family did not learn for decades.

title: Born a Crime
author: Trevor Noah
description: Born to a Black South African mother and a white Swiss father under apartheid, when their relationship itself was a crime, Trevor Noah recounts a childhood spent surviving and laughing.

title: Becoming
author: Michelle Obama
description: The former First Lady traces her journey from the South Side of Chicago to the White House, and what she carried with her the whole way.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: In a world engineered for painless happiness, one man's exposure to poetry, pain, and freedom makes him a danger to everyone's contentment.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
author: J.D. Salinger
description: Expelled from prep school days before Christmas, Holden Caulfield wanders New York for three days, unable to stand the phoniness of the adult world he is about to enter.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A destitute former student murders a pawnbroker to test his theory that extraordinary men are above the law, and cannot outrun his own conscience afterward.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Bronte
description: The obsessive, destructive love between Heathcliff and Catherine tears through two families across the Yorkshire moors and two generations.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
description: Captain Ahab drives the whaling ship Pequod across the oceans in a monomaniacal hunt for the white whale that took his leg, and his sanity with it.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist assembles a living being from scavenged parts, then recoils in horror from his own creation, setting loose a tragedy neither of them can escape.

title: Eragon
author: Christopher Paolini
description: A farm boy finds a mysterious blue stone in the mountains that hatches into a dragon, thrusting him into a destiny of magic and rebellion against a tyrant king.

title: The Night Circus
author: Erin Morgenstern
description: Two young illusionists are bound since childhood to a magical duel neither of them chose, staged across the tents of a circus that only opens at night.

title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
author: Agatha Christie
description: When a wealthy widower is murdered hours after learning a devastating secret, Hercule Poirot comes out of retirement to untangle a village full of quiet lies.

title: Sharp Objects
author: Gillian Flynn
description: A troubled reporter returns to her hometown to cover the murders of two young girls and finds herself pulled back into the toxic orbit of her own family.

title: Outliers: The Story of Success
author: Malcolm Gladwell
description: Malcolm Gladwell argues that talent alone rarely explains extraordinary success, tracing the hidden advantages of timing, culture, and opportunity behind it.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: Stephen Hawking guides readers from the Big Bang to black holes in a landmark attempt to explain the universe's deepest questions without a single equation.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: Two teenagers meet at a cancer support group and fall in love on their own terms, determined to live fully in whatever time they are given.

title: Twilight
author: Stephenie Meyer
description: A teenager who moves to a rainy Pacific Northwest town falls for a mysterious classmate who turns out to be far older, and far more dangerous, than he seems.

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: Moments before Earth is demolished to make way for a hyperspace bypass, an ordinary man is swept off the planet by his best friend, who turns out to be an alien.

title: Ready Player One
author: Ernest Cline
description: In a virtual utopia that has become humanity's escape from a bleak future, a teenager hunts for an easter egg hidden by the system's late creator, worth a fortune to whoever finds it first.
